strings.name: Susumu Kitagawa
strings.summary: Trained at Kyoto, Kitagawa taught at Kindai, Tokyo Metropolitan and Kyoto universities. His teams investigated porous coordination polymers by gas adsorption and developed flexible frameworks responsive to guest molecules for storage and separation. He shared the 2025 chemistry Nobel with Robson and Yaghi. Applications reflect sustained work by many teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Advances porous coordination polymers and metal–organic frameworks, expanding materials applications in gas storage, adsorption and separation.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Gas adsorption

strings.highlights.h2.title: Flexible frameworks
strings.highlights.h2.text: Studied frameworks responsive to guest molecules for selective separation.
